capabilities.implementation: Playwright CLI driving the installed Edge
capabilities.notes: No browser download: uses the msedge channel. Chosen over Playwright MCP (always-on tool schemas), Chrome DevTools MCP (Edge not officially supported, usage statistics on by default) and Claude in Chrome (unavailable on Bedrock/gateway). Fallback if the CLI session daemon is unstable on Windows: Playwright MCP with --browser msedge --headless.

capabilities.implementation: Local sources, type definitions and docs of the installed versions, read with the agent's file tools
capabilities.notes: No extra product and no outbound traffic. Chosen over hosted Context7 (queries leave the network, community-curated content, extra SaaS domain to approve). Move to WebFetch with an allowlist of official documentation domains when narrative docs are needed and the network team approves; Context7 on-premise is the option for searching private internal library docs.
